description:
Lancer RPG/Battlegroup
From a distance, it is elegant; Up close, it is hell.

Download version 0.0.2

Overview

It is the year 5000u. The disparate elements of RINGAD Koenig are in the midst of assembling to counter the Aunic threat. The 10th Ring Fleet will deploy as a wholly coherent force for the first time. But much of the fleet never emerge from the mustering point's blinkgate. Instead, they arrive through a rather different gate, in another version of the Milky Way entirely. . .

This is a ship, weapon, and a (small) faction mod based on the Lancer RPG setting created by Massif Press*. Currently, there is one cruiser** and one weapon implemented.
This is a very tentative state of affairs, and any feedback (balancing, bugs, etc.) is highly appreciated.

*It has a fleet battle spinoff! Check out Lancer Battlegroup.
**A note on terminology. In the Lancer setting, frigates are the second largest direct combat vessels and the smallest lineships (after the battleships), thus being the equivalent to the cruisers of most settings. Cruisers, destroyers and corvettes are terms reserved for subline ships that rely on dedicated tenders or carriers.

Features

The Caspian Sea: a dependable, if expensive cruiser with several universal slots and a target lock ship system that amplifies damage done to a single target.
The Thoreau: A heavily-armed battleship purely focused on maximum firepower. It is also equipped with a feature that will be shared with every capital in this mod: the first of many swappable superheavy spinal weapons.
The 3x3 Block Short-Spool Cannons: A fearsome array of 9 spinally-mounted heavy cannons. Currently, it fires in a sequential burst of 9 energy damage rounds, but that may change once I find the time to manually animate the recoil (feel-free to pitch in with ideas!)
The Short-cycle Primary Lance: a large energy weapon which acts as something of a direct progression from the Phase Lance. It is significantly shorter ranged than the Tachyon Lance, but does significantly more damage. Available from the same sources as the Caspian Sea.
Faction Addition: The Union faction is "fully" implemented to this build, with a flag (attached below), flavor text for their system, Nex integrations, and codex lore. However, input would be appreciated on whether or not they should be kept at this point in development, with only 2 unique ships to their name.

Changelog:

Spoiler
v0.0.2
Added Union as a faction.
Added the Thoreau-class battleship along with the superheavy spinal 3x3 Block Short-Spool Cannons.

Sprites (Ships commissioned from Tandem Charge (@TandemCharge on X/Twitter))

Spoiler
Caspian Sea
Thoreau (w/ 3x3 Block Short-Spool Cannons)
Short Cycle Primary Lance
Faction Flag

Other Credits
This mod was (badly) created using wispborne's Intellij template (https://github.com/wispborne/Starsector-IntelliJ-Template).
It made the process much easier than it would have been otherwise.

discordPostHtml:
A mod which adds in ships, weapons, and (in the future) factions from Massif Press's Lancer RPG setting.

Current Features:

  • The Caspian Sea frigate*: a dependable, if expensive cruiser with several universal slots and a system which marks a target for additional damage. For now, it is currently available in the high-tech blueprint package, as a rare Independent ship, and as a solo blueprint drop.
  • The** Short-cycle Primary Lance**: a large energy weapon which acts as something of a direct progression from the Phase Lance. It is significantly shorter ranged than the Tachyon Lance, but does significantly more damage. Available from the same sources as the Caspian Sea.

*A note on terminology: In the Lancer setting, "frigate" is the term used for the second largest independent combat vessels, similarly to how "cruiser" is usually used in Starsector and other settings. Cruiser, destroyer and corvette are terms reserved for "subline " ships that rely on dedicated tenders or carriers.

All current sprites were commissioned from
Any feedback/suggestions for the content (as little as there is) would be appreciated! Feel free to DM,

Changelog:
0.0.1
* Initial Release
